	public static void startInit()
	{
		try
		{
			LoaderGM.curStep = LoaderSteps.loadingTheme;
			string themesDir = Utils.currentMod.RootDir + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Themes" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
			DBModInfo["-1"] = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			DBModInfo["-1"]["name"] = "";
			if (!Settings.disableDefaultThemes)
			{
				loadThemesInFolder("-1", themesDir, prefix: true);
			}
			else
			{
				if (Settings.curTheme.StartsWith("-1"))
				{
					Settings.curTheme = VanillaThemeID;
				}
				LogMsg("Skip all default themes : disabled in user's settings");
			}
			DBAnimatedBackground[VanillaThemeID] = Utils.currentMod.RootDir + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Rtrsc" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "VanillaVBG.webm";
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			LogError("Cannot load core : " + ex.Message);
			return;
		}
		try
		{
			string text = Utils.RWBaseFolderPath + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "RimThemes" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
			if (Directory.Exists(text))
			{
				DBModInfo["-2"] = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				DBModInfo["-2"]["name"] = "";
				loadThemesInFolder("-2", text, prefix: true);
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex2)
		{
			LogError("Cannot load default themes : " + ex2.Message);
		}
		string text2 = "";
		try
		{
			List<ModContentPack> runningModsListForReading = LoadedModManager.RunningModsListForReading;
			for (int num = runningModsListForReading.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				ModContentPack val = runningModsListForReading[num];
				text2 = val.RootDir + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "RimThemes";
				if (Directory.Exists(text2))
				{
					try
					{
						DBModInfo[val.PackageId] = new Dictionary<string, string>();
						DBModInfo[val.PackageId]["name"] = val.Name;
						loadThemesInFolder(val.PackageId, text2, prefix: false);
					}
					catch (Exception ex3)
					{
						LogError("Cannot load " + val.Name + "'s themes : " + ex3.Message);
					}
				}
			}
			CustomCursor.Deactivate();
			CustomCursor.Activate();
			if (!DBAvailableThemes.Contains(Settings.curTheme))
			{
				currentThemeExist = false;
			}
			initialized = true;
		}
		catch (Exception ex4)
		{
			LogError(" Unhandled error at startInit : " + ex4.Message);
		}
	}

	private static void loadThemesInFolder(string modID, string themesDir, bool prefix)
	{
		//IL_0863: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_086a: Expected O, but got Unknown
		LogMsg("Searching themes in " + themesDir + "...");
		string[] directories = Directory.GetDirectories(themesDir);
		LogMsg("Found " + directories.Count() + " themes");
		try
		{
			string[] array = directories;
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				string text2 = text.Remove(0, text.LastIndexOf(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar) + 1);
				string text3 = modID + "" + text2;
				if (modID == "-1" && !Utils.isDefaultThemeAllowed(text2))
				{
					if (Settings.curTheme == text3)
					{
						Settings.curTheme = VanillaThemeID;
					}
					LogMsg("Skip default theme '" + text2 + "' : disabled in user's settings");
					continue;
				}
				string text4 = themesDir + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + text2 + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
				LoaderGM.curTheme = text2;
				LogMsg("Loading theme : " + text2);
				RDBTex[text3] = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, byte[]>>();
				string text5 = text4 + "Misc" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Icon.png";
				if (File.Exists(text5))
				{
					RDBTexThemeIcon[text3] = rawBytesLoad(text5);
				}
				else
				{
					DBTexThemeIcon[text3] = Loader.defaultIconTex;
				}
				string text6 = text4 + "Misc" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Particle.png";
				if (File.Exists(text6))
				{
					RDBTexParticle[text3] = rawBytesLoad(text6);
				}
				else
				{
					RDBTexParticle[text3] = null;
				}
				string path = text4 + "Misc" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Tapestry";
				if (Utils.texFileExist(path))
				{
					RDBTexTapestry[text3] = Utils.readAllBytesTexFile(path);
				}
				else
				{
					RDBTexTapestry[text3] = null;
				}
				string text7 = text4 + "Loader" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "LoaderBar.png";
				if (File.Exists(text7))
				{
					RDBTexLoaderBar[text3] = rawBytesLoad(text7);
				}
				else
				{
					RDBTexLoaderBar[text3] = null;
				}
				string text8 = text4 + "Loader" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "TextBar.png";
				if (File.Exists(text8))
				{
					RDBTexLoaderText[text3] = rawBytesLoad(text8);
				}
				else
				{
					RDBTexLoaderText[text3] = null;
				}
				string path2 = text4 + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Textures";
				string text9 = "";
				try
				{
					if (Directory.Exists(path2))
					{
						string[] files = Directory.GetFiles(path2);
						string[] array2 = files;
						foreach (string text10 in array2)
						{
							text9 = Path.GetExtension(text10);
							if (text9 == null || !Utils.isValidImgExt(text9.ToLower()))
							{
								continue;
							}
							string fileNameWithoutExtension = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(text10);
							if (fileNameWithoutExtension.IndexOf('.') == -1)
							{
								LogMsg("Bad tex name for " + fileNameWithoutExtension + " cannot get className and fieldName");
								continue;
							}
							string[] classNameAndFileName = getClassNameAndFileName(fileNameWithoutExtension);
							if (classNameAndFileName.Count() != 2)
							{
								LogMsg("Bad tex name for " + fileNameWithoutExtension);
								continue;
							}
							if (!RDBTex[text3].ContainsKey(classNameAndFileName[0]) || RDBTex[text3][classNameAndFileName[0]] == null)
							{
								RDBTex[text3][classNameAndFileName[0]] = new Dictionary<string, byte[]>();
							}
							try
							{
								if (classNameAndFileName[1].Contains("@"))
								{
									int num = classNameAndFileName[1].LastIndexOf("@");
									if (num >= 0)
									{
										classNameAndFileName[1] = classNameAndFileName[1].Substring(0, num);
									}
									if (!RDBTexDyn.ContainsKey(text3))
									{
										RDBTexDyn[text3] = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, List<byte[]>>>();
									}
									if (!RDBTexDyn[text3].ContainsKey(classNameAndFileName[0]))
									{
										RDBTexDyn[text3][classNameAndFileName[0]] = new Dictionary<string, List<byte[]>>();
									}
									if (!RDBTexDyn[text3][classNameAndFileName[0]].ContainsKey(classNameAndFileName[1]))
									{
										RDBTexDyn[text3][classNameAndFileName[0]][classNameAndFileName[1]] = new List<byte[]>();
									}
									RDBTexDyn[text3][classNameAndFileName[0]][classNameAndFileName[1]].Add(rawBytesLoad(text10));
									if (!RDBTex[text3][classNameAndFileName[0]].ContainsKey(classNameAndFileName[1]))
									{
										RDBTex[text3][classNameAndFileName[0]][classNameAndFileName[1]] = null;
									}
								}
								else
								{
									RDBTex[text3][classNameAndFileName[0]][classNameAndFileName[1]] = rawBytesLoad(text10);
								}
							}
							catch (Exception ex)
							{
								LogError("Invalid custom texture " + fileNameWithoutExtension + " : " + ex.Message);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					LogError("Fatal error in custom textures processing : " + ex2.Message);
				}
				string path3 = text + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Textures";
				DirectoryInfo directoryInfo = new DirectoryInfo(path3);
				IOrderedEnumerable<FileInfo> orderedEnumerable = from f in directoryInfo.GetFiles()
					where f.Name.StartsWith("UI_BackgroundMain.BGPlanet") && f.Extension == ".webm"
					orderby f.LastWriteTime descending
					select f;
				if (orderedEnumerable.Count() >= 1)
				{
					try
					{
						if (!DBAnimatedBackgroundDyn.ContainsKey(text3) || DBAnimatedBackgroundDyn[text3] == null)
						{
							DBAnimatedBackgroundDyn[text3] = new List<string>();
						}
						foreach (FileInfo item in orderedEnumerable)
						{
							DBAnimatedBackgroundDyn[text3].Add(item.FullName);
							DBAnimatedBackground[text3] = item.FullName;
							LogMsg("Found and loading animated background " + item.FullName);
						}
					}
					catch (Exception ex3)
					{
						LogError("Error while trying to load animated background : " + ex3.Message);
					}
				}
				string metaPath = text + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "meta.xml";
				processMetaXML(text3, metaPath);
				if (!DBText[text3].ContainsKey("category") || !Dialog_ThemesList.categoriesID.Contains(DBText[text3]["category"]))
				{
					DBText[text3]["category"] = "other";
				}
				string path4 = text + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Sounds";
				try
				{
					if (Directory.Exists(path4))
					{
						Type type = Type.GetType(typeof(SoundDefOf).AssemblyQualifiedName);
						DBSound[text3] = new Dictionary<string, AudioGrain_ClipTheme>();
						string[] files2 = Directory.GetFiles(path4);
						string[] array3 = files2;
						foreach (string text11 in array3)
						{
							string fileNameWithoutExtension2 = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(text11);
							try
							{
								FieldInfo field = type.GetField(fileNameWithoutExtension2);
								SoundDef val = (SoundDef)field.GetValue(null);
								DBSound[text3][fileNameWithoutExtension2] = new AudioGrain_ClipTheme();
								DBSound[text3][fileNameWithoutExtension2].themeClipPath = text11;
								LogMsg("Loading custom sound " + fileNameWithoutExtension2 + " OK");
							}
							catch (Exception ex4)
							{
								LogError("Invalid custom sound " + fileNameWithoutExtension2 + " : " + ex4.Message);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex5)
				{
					LogError("Fatal error in custom sound processing : " + ex5.Message);
				}
				string path5 = text + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Songs";
				try
				{
					if (Directory.Exists(path5))
					{
						DBSong[text3] = new Dictionary<string, AudioClip>();
						string[] files3 = Directory.GetFiles(path5);
						DBSongsToLoad[text3] = new Dictionary<string, string>();
						string[] array4 = files3;
						foreach (string text12 in array4)
						{
							string extension = Path.GetExtension(text12);
							if (File.Exists(text12) && extension != null && extension.ToLower() == ".ogg")
							{
								string fileNameWithoutExtension3 = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(text12);
								DBSongsToLoad[text3][fileNameWithoutExtension3] = text12;
								LogMsg("Append " + fileNameWithoutExtension3 + " song to preload songs list");
							}
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex6)
				{
					LogError("Fatal error in custom song pre-processing : " + ex6.Message);
				}
				DBAvailableThemes.Add(text3);
			}
			string text13 = themesDir + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "fontsPackage";
			try
			{
				if (File.Exists(text13))
				{
					DBfontsBundleToLoad.Add(text13);
					LogMsg("Found a font bundle");
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex7)
			{
				LogError("Fatal error in custom fonts package pre-processing : " + ex7.Message);
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex8)
		{
			LogError("Fatal error in loadThemesInFolder : " + ex8.Message);
		}
	}

	public static void processMetaXML(string themeID, string metaPath)
	{
		//IL_01f7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0d94: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0c2c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0c31: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0c39: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_082f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0834: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0df9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0dfe: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0e13: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0e18: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0e25: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0e27: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0a2c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0a31: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_09b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0974: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0984: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_09e4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0bb4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0b84: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0be4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0bd4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_09a4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_09c4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0994: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_09d4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0b94: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0bc4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0b74: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0ba4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		DBDynColor[themeID] = new Dictionary<Color, Color>();
		DBColor[themeID] = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, Color>>();
		DBText[themeID] = new Dictionary<string, string>();
		if (!DBVal.ContainsKey(themeID))
		{
			DBVal[themeID] = new Dictionary<string, int>();
			DBVal[themeID]["loaderfps"] = 20;
		}
		if (!File.Exists(metaPath))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (RDBTex.ContainsKey(themeID))
		{
			RDBTex[themeID]["buttonbarcolor"] = null;
		}
		DBText[themeID]["description"] = "";
		DBGUIStyle[themeID] = null;
		Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
		DBColor[themeID][MiscKey] = new Dictionary<string, Color>();
		try
		{
			using (XmlReader xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(metaPath))
			{
				xmlReader.MoveToContent();
				while (xmlReader.Read())
				{
					if (xmlReader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Element)
					{
						continue;
					}
					string text = xmlReader.Name.ToString();
					string text2 = xmlReader.ReadString();
					if (text.IndexOf('.') != -1)
					{
						string[] classNameAndFileName = getClassNameAndFileName(text);
						if (classNameAndFileName.Count() != 2)
						{
							LogMsg("Bad color tag " + text);
							continue;
						}
						if (!DBColor[themeID].ContainsKey(classNameAndFileName[0]) || DBColor[themeID][classNameAndFileName[0]] == null)
						{
							DBColor[themeID][classNameAndFileName[0]] = new Dictionary<string, Color>();
						}
						try
						{
							DBColor[themeID][classNameAndFileName[0]][classNameAndFileName[1]] = (Color)ParseHelper.FromString(text2, typeof(Color));
						}
						catch (Exception ex)
						{
							LogError("Cannot parse field " + text + " : " + ex.Message);
						}
						continue;
					}
					text = text.ToLower().Trim();
					text2 = text2.Trim();
					try
					{
						switch (text)
						{
						case "textcolorwhite":
						case "textcolorcyan":
						case "textcolorgray":
						case "textcolorred":
						case "textcoloryellow":
						case "textcolorblue":
						case "textcolorgreen":
						case "textcolormangenta":
							try
							{
								Color value4 = (Color)ParseHelper.FromString(text2, typeof(Color));
								switch (text)
								{
								case "textcolorwhite":
									DBTextColorWhite[themeID] = value4;
									break;
								case "textcolorcyan":
									DBTextColorCyan[themeID] = value4;
									break;
								case "textcolorgray":
									DBTextColorGray[themeID] = value4;
									break;
								case "textcolorred":
									DBTextColorRed[themeID] = value4;
									break;
								case "textcoloryellow":
									DBTextColorYellow[themeID] = value4;
									break;
								case "textcolorblue":
									DBTextColorBlue[themeID] = value4;
									break;
								case "textcolorgreen":
									DBTextColorGreen[themeID] = value4;
									break;
								case "textcolormagenta":
									DBTextColorMagenta[themeID] = value4;
									break;
								}
							}
							catch (Exception ex4)
							{
								LogMsg("Cannot parse textcolor white field " + text + " : " + ex4.Message);
							}
							break;
						case "texturecolorwhite":
						case "texturecolorcyan":
						case "texturecolorgray":
						case "texturecolorred":
						case "texturecoloryellow":
						case "texturecolorblue":
						case "texturecolorgreen":
						case "texturecolormangenta":
							try
							{
								Color value2 = (Color)ParseHelper.FromString(text2, typeof(Color));
								switch (text)
								{
								case "texturecolorwhite":
									DBTexColorWhite[themeID] = value2;
									break;
								case "texturecolorcyan":
									DBTexColorCyan[themeID] = value2;
									break;
								case "texturecolorgray":
									DBTexColorGray[themeID] = value2;
									break;
								case "texturecolorred":
									DBTexColorRed[themeID] = value2;
									break;
								case "texturecoloryellow":
									DBTexColorYellow[themeID] = value2;
									break;
								case "texturecolorblue":
									DBTexColorBlue[themeID] = value2;
									break;
								case "texturecolorgreen":
									DBTexColorGreen[themeID] = value2;
									break;
								case "textureolormagenta":
									DBTexColorMagenta[themeID] = value2;
									break;
								}
							}
							catch (Exception ex3)
							{
								LogMsg("Cannot parse texureColor white field " + text + " : " + ex3.Message);
							}
							break;
						case "textcolorfactionneutral":
							try
							{
								Color value = (Color)ParseHelper.FromString(text2, typeof(Color));
								DBTextColorFactionsNeutral[themeID] = value;
							}
							catch (Exception ex2)
							{
								LogMsg("Cannot parse textcolor faction neutral : " + ex2.Message);
							}
							break;
						case "font":
						{
							Dictionary<string, string> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<string, string>();
							dictionary["font"] = text2;
							dictionary["themeID"] = themeID;
							break;
						}
						case "windowanim":
							switch (text2.ToLower())
							{
							case "clip":
								DBWindowAnim[themeID] = WindowAnim.Clip;
								break;
							case "slideleft":
								DBWindowAnim[themeID] = WindowAnim.SlideLeft;
								break;
							case "slideright":
								DBWindowAnim[themeID] = WindowAnim.SlideRight;
								break;
							case "slidetop":
								DBWindowAnim[themeID] = WindowAnim.SlideTop;
								break;
							case "slidebottom":
								DBWindowAnim[themeID] = WindowAnim.SlideBottom;
								break;
							default:
								DBWindowAnim[themeID] = WindowAnim.None;
								break;
							}
							break;
						case "particlemode":
						case "buttonnotex":
						case "buttonnobg":
						case "buttonusecolor":
						case "dialogstacking":
						case "disablemainrimthemeslogo":
						case "disablemainthemeselector":
						case "category":
						case "tapestryscalemode":
							DBText[themeID][text] = text2.ToLower();
							break;
						case "buttonfillcolor":
						case "buttonhovercolor":
						case "buttonclickcolor":
						case "tapestrybordercolor":
							DBColor[themeID][MiscKey][text] = (Color)ParseHelper.FromString(text2, typeof(Color));
							break;
						case "dyncolor":
						{
							string[] array = text2.Split('=');
							if (array.Count() == 2)
							{
								LogMsg("Found dynColor " + array[0] + " => " + array[1]);
								Color key = (Color)ParseHelper.FromString(array[0], typeof(Color));
								Color value3 = (Color)ParseHelper.FromString(array[1], typeof(Color));
								DBDynColor[themeID][key] = value3;
							}
							break;
						}
						case "disabletransparenttext":
						case "menuspecialmode":
						case "loaderfps":
						{
							int result = 0;
							if (int.TryParse(text2, out result))
							{
								DBVal[themeID][text] = result;
								break;
							}
							LogError("DBVal : value '" + text2 + "' of tag '" + text + "' is not a valid number");
							break;
						}
						default:
							DBText[themeID][text] = text2;
							Fonts.tryParseCustomFontTag(dictionary, themeID, text, text2);
							break;
						}
					}
					catch (Exception ex5)
					{
						LogError("Cannot parse tag " + text + " : " + ex5.Message);
					}
				}
			}
			if (dictionary.Count() != 0)
			{
				fontsToLoad.Add(dictionary);
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex6)
		{
			LogError("Cannot parse meta.xml " + ex6.Message);
		}
	}

	public static Texture2D customTexLoad(string fullPath, int w = 64, int h = 64)
	{
		//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
		Texture2D val = new Texture2D(w, h, (TextureFormat)4, false);
		ImageConversion.LoadImage(val, File.ReadAllBytes(fullPath));
		return val;
	}

	public static byte[] rawBytesLoad(string fullPath)
	{
		return File.ReadAllBytes(fullPath);
	}

	public static void changeThemeNow(string modID, string themeName, bool manualChange)
	{
		string newTheme = modID + "" + themeName;
		changeThemeNow(newTheme, manualChange);
	}

	public static void changeThemeNow(string newTheme, bool manualChange = false)
	{
		try
		{
			if (manualChange)
			{
				currentThemeExist = true;
			}
			string curTheme = Settings.curTheme;
			if (!vanillaThemeSaved)
			{
				LogMsg("Saving vanilla theme...");
				saveVanillaRsc(DBTex);
				saveVanillaRsc(DBColor);
				DBDynColor[VanillaThemeID] = new Dictionary<Color, Color>();
				DBText[VanillaThemeID] = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				DBText[VanillaThemeID]["description"] = "Want some old school interface ?";
				LogMsg("Saving vanilla theme ending");
				vanillaThemeSaved = true;
				Utils.applyWindowFillColorOpacityOverride(newTheme);
				changeThemeNow(newTheme, manualChange);
				if (curTheme == VanillaThemeID)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (curTheme != VanillaThemeID)
			{
				changeTheme(DBTex, VanillaThemeID);
				changeTheme(DBColor, VanillaThemeID);
				changeThemeOtherMods(VanillaThemeID);
			}
			string curThemeForBackgroundRegen = Settings.getCurThemeForBackgroundRegen(newTheme);
			if (DBTexDyn.ContainsKey(curThemeForBackgroundRegen))
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Dictionary<string, List<Texture2D>>> item in DBTexDyn[curThemeForBackgroundRegen])
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, List<Texture2D>> item2 in item.Value)
					{
						bool flag = item.Key == "UI_BackgroundMain" && item2.Key == "BGPlanet";
						if (DBTex.ContainsKey(curThemeForBackgroundRegen) && DBTex[curThemeForBackgroundRegen].ContainsKey(item.Key) && DBTex[curThemeForBackgroundRegen][item.Key].ContainsKey(item2.Key) && (!flag || (flag && !Settings.keepCurrentBg)))
						{
							Random random = new Random();
							int num = random.Next(0, item2.Value.Count);
							DBTex[curThemeForBackgroundRegen][item.Key][item2.Key] = item2.Value[num];
							if (flag)
							{
								Settings.curRandomBgIndex = num;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			shuffleAnimatedBackgrounds(newTheme);
			stopCurrentAnimatedBackground();
			changeTheme(DBTex, newTheme);
			changeTheme(DBColor, newTheme);
			changeThemeOtherMods(newTheme);
			Utils.resetCachedLabelWidthCache();
			Settings.curTheme = newTheme;
			((ModSettings)Utils.modSettings).Write();
			changeSoundTheme();
			changeSongTheme();
			CustomCursor.Deactivate();
			CustomCursor.Activate();
			Utils.needRefresh = true;
			Utils.applyWindowFillColorOpacityOverride(newTheme);
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			LogError("Error while trying to change theme : " + ex.Message);
		}
	}

	public static void shuffleAnimatedBackgrounds(string newTheme)
	{
		string curThemeForBackgroundRegen = Settings.getCurThemeForBackgroundRegen(newTheme);
		if (!Settings.keepCurrentBg)
		{
			if (DBAnimatedBackgroundDyn.ContainsKey(curThemeForBackgroundRegen) && DBAnimatedBackgroundDyn[curThemeForBackgroundRegen].Count() > 0)
			{
				Random random = new Random();
				int num = random.Next(0, DBAnimatedBackgroundDyn[curThemeForBackgroundRegen].Count);
				DBAnimatedBackground[curThemeForBackgroundRegen] = DBAnimatedBackgroundDyn[curThemeForBackgroundRegen][num];
				Settings.curRandomBgIndex = num;
			}
			else if (Settings.forceVanillaVideoBgWhenNoVBG)
			{
				DBAnimatedBackground[curThemeForBackgroundRegen] = DBAnimatedBackground[VanillaThemeID];
				Settings.curRandomBgIndex = 0;
			}
		}
	}

	public static void changeSongTheme()
	{
		//IL_0163: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_016a: Expected O, but got Unknown
		//IL_0180: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0187: Expected O, but got Unknown
		//IL_019d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_01a4: Expected O, but got Unknown
		string text = Settings.curTheme;
		if (Settings.disableCustomSongs)
		{
			text = VanillaThemeID;
		}
		if (!vanillaSongGrainsSaved)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!DBSong.ContainsKey(VanillaThemeID))
				{
					DBSong[VanillaThemeID] = new Dictionary<string, AudioClip>();
				}
				DBSong[VanillaThemeID]["EntrySong"] = SongDefOf.EntrySong.clip;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				LogError("Cannot save vanilla song " + ex.Message);
			}
			vanillaSongGrainsSaved = true;
		}
		else
		{
			SongDefOf.EntrySong.clip = DBSong[VanillaThemeID]["EntrySong"];
		}
		if (!DBSong.ContainsKey(text) || DBSong[text] == null || !DBSong[text].ContainsKey("EntrySong"))
		{
			text = VanillaThemeID;
		}
		try
		{
			SongDefOf.EntrySong.clip = DBSong[text]["EntrySong"];
			Type type = Type.GetType(typeof(Current).AssemblyQualifiedName);
			if (!(type != null))
			{
				return;
			}
			FieldInfo field = type.GetField("rootEntryInt", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			Root_Entry val = (Root_Entry)field.GetValue(null);
			MusicManagerEntry val2 = (MusicManagerEntry)Traverse.Create((object)val).Field("musicManagerEntry").GetValue();
			AudioSource val3 = (AudioSource)Traverse.Create((object)val2).Field("audioSource").GetValue();
			if ((Object)(object)val3 != (Object)null)
			{
				val3.Stop();
				if (text == VanillaThemeID || !DBEntrySongDyn.ContainsKey(text))
				{
					val3.clip = DBSong[text]["EntrySong"];
				}
				else
				{
					val3.clip = GenCollection.RandomElement<AudioClip>((IEnumerable<AudioClip>)DBEntrySongDyn[text]);
				}
				val3.Play();
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex2)
		{
			LogError("changeSoundTheme : " + ex2.Message);
		}
	}

	public static void changeSoundTheme()
	{
		//IL_00a6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_00ad: Expected O, but got Unknown
		string key = Settings.curTheme;
		if (Settings.disableCustomSounds)
		{
			key = VanillaThemeID;
		}
		if (!vanillaGrainsSaved)
		{
			saveVanillaGrains();
			vanillaGrainsSaved = true;
		}
		else
		{
			restoreVanilaGrains();
		}
		if (!DBSound.ContainsKey(key))
		{
			return;
		}
		Type type = Type.GetType(typeof(SoundDefOf).AssemblyQualifiedName);
		foreach (KeyValuePair<string, AudioGrain_ClipTheme> item in DBSound[key])
		{
			try
			{
				string key2 = item.Key;
				FieldInfo field = type.GetField(key2);
				SoundDef val = (SoundDef)field.GetValue(null);
				val.subSounds[0].grains[0] = (AudioGrain)(object)item.Value;
				((Editable)val.subSounds[0]).ResolveReferences();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				LogError("changeSoundTheme : " + ex.Message);
			}
		}
	}

	public static void saveVanillaGrains()
	{
		//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_003d: Expected O, but got Unknown
		Type type = Type.GetType(typeof(SoundDefOf).AssemblyQualifiedName);
		FieldInfo[] fields = type.GetFields();
		FieldInfo[] array = fields;
		foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in array)
		{
			try
			{
				SoundDef val = (SoundDef)fieldInfo.GetValue(null);
				if (val.subSounds.Count != 0)
				{
					List<ResolvedGrain> list = (List<ResolvedGrain>)Traverse.Create((object)val.subSounds[0]).Field("resolvedGrains").GetValue();
					DBVanillaResolvedGrains[fieldInfo.Name] = new List<ResolvedGrain>();
					foreach (ResolvedGrain item in list)
					{
						DBVanillaResolvedGrains[fieldInfo.Name].Add(item);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					DBVanillaResolvedGrains[fieldInfo.Name] = null;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (fieldInfo != null)
				{
					LogError("Cannot save vanilla grain " + fieldInfo.Name + " : " + ex.Message);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public static void restoreVanilaGrains()
	{
		//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_003c: Expected O, but got Unknown
		Type type = Type.GetType(typeof(SoundDefOf).AssemblyQualifiedName);
		FieldInfo[] fields = type.GetFields();
		FieldInfo[] array = fields;
		foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in array)
		{
			SoundDef val = (SoundDef)fieldInfo.GetValue(null);
			if (DBVanillaResolvedGrains[fieldInfo.Name] == null)
			{
				continue;
			}
			List<ResolvedGrain> list = (List<ResolvedGrain>)Traverse.Create((object)val.subSounds[0]).Field("resolvedGrains").GetValue();
			list.Clear();
			foreach (ResolvedGrain item in DBVanillaResolvedGrains[fieldInfo.Name])
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
		}
	}

	public static void changeTheme<T>(Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, T>>> db, string forcedTheme = null)
	{
		//IL_01b7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_01e0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_01ea: Expected O, but got Unknown
		//IL_01ef: Expected O, but got Unknown
		string key = ((forcedTheme == null) ? Settings.curTheme : forcedTheme);
		bool flag = true;
		Dictionary<string, List<FOI>> dictionary = fieldsOfInterestTex;
		if (!db.ContainsKey(key))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (typeof(T) != typeof(Texture2D))
		{
			flag = false;
			dictionary = fieldsOfInterestColor;
		}
		foreach (KeyValuePair<string, List<FOI>> item in dictionary)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!db[key].ContainsKey(item.Key))
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text = "Verse";
				if (flag)
				{
					if (fieldsOfInterestTexNS.ContainsKey(item.Key))
					{
						text = fieldsOfInterestTexNS[item.Key];
					}
				}
				else if (fieldsOfInterestColorNS.ContainsKey(item.Key))
				{
					text = fieldsOfInterestColorNS[item.Key];
				}
				Type type = typeof(FloatMenuOption).Assembly.GetType(text + "." + item.Key);
				foreach (FOI item2 in item.Value)
				{
					try
					{
						if (db[key][item.Key].ContainsKey(item2.field) && db[key][item.Key][item2.field] != null)
						{
							if (flag)
							{
								ImageConversion.LoadImage((Texture2D)type.GetField(item2.field, item2.bf).GetValue(null), ImageConversion.EncodeToPNG((Texture2D)(object)db[key][item.Key][item2.field]));
							}
							else
							{
								type.GetField(item2.field, item2.bf).SetValue(null, db[key][item.Key][item2.field]);
							}
						}
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						LogMsg(string.Concat("changeTheme (", typeof(T), ") : Cannot set field ", item.Key, ".", item2.field, " : ", ex.Message));
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				LogError(string.Concat("changeTheme (", typeof(T), ") : Cannot get class ", item.Key, " : ", ex2.Message));
			}
		}
	}

	public static void changeThemeOtherMods(string theme)
	{
		//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_00a6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_00de: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0116: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_014e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		BindingFlags bindingAttr = BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic;
		Assembly[] assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
		for (int i = 0; i != assemblies.Count(); i++)
		{
			try
			{
				if (assemblies[i].GetName().Name == "RecipeIcons")
				{
					Type type = assemblies[i].GetType("RecipeIcons.FloatMenuOptionLeft");
					type.GetField("ColorBGActive", bindingAttr).SetValue(null, DBColor[theme]["FloatMenuOption"]["ColorBGActive"]);
					type.GetField("ColorBGActiveMouseover", bindingAttr).SetValue(null, DBColor[theme]["FloatMenuOption"]["ColorBGActiveMouseover"]);
					type.GetField("ColorBGDisabled", bindingAttr).SetValue(null, DBColor[theme]["FloatMenuOption"]["ColorBGDisabled"]);
					type.GetField("ColorTextActive", bindingAttr).SetValue(null, DBColor[theme]["FloatMenuOption"]["ColorTextActive"]);
					type.GetField("ColorTextDisabled", bindingAttr).SetValue(null, DBColor[theme]["FloatMenuOption"]["ColorTextDisabled"]);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				LogError("Cannot apply theme on custom assembly : " + ex.Message);
			}
		}
	}

	public static void saveVanillaRsc<T>(Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, T>>> db)
	{
		//IL_0234: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_023b: Expected O, but got Unknown
		//IL_027b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0282: Expected O, but got Unknown
		//IL_029e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_01ea: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0162: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0169: Expected O, but got Unknown
		//IL_0182: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_018c: Expected O, but got Unknown
		string vanillaThemeID = VanillaThemeID;
		db[vanillaThemeID] = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, T>>();
		Dictionary<string, List<FOI>> dictionary = fieldsOfInterestTex;
		bool flag = true;
		if (typeof(T) != typeof(Texture2D))
		{
			flag = false;
			dictionary = fieldsOfInterestColor;
		}
		foreach (KeyValuePair<string, List<FOI>> item in dictionary)
		{
			try
			{
				db[vanillaThemeID][item.Key] = new Dictionary<string, T>();
				string text = "Verse";
				if (flag)
				{
					if (fieldsOfInterestTexNS.ContainsKey(item.Key))
					{
						text = fieldsOfInterestTexNS[item.Key];
					}
				}
				else if (fieldsOfInterestColorNS.ContainsKey(item.Key))
				{
					text = fieldsOfInterestColorNS[item.Key];
				}
				Type type = typeof(FloatMenuOption).Assembly.GetType(text + "." + item.Key);
				foreach (FOI item2 in item.Value)
				{
					try
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							Dictionary<string, Texture2D> dictionary2 = (Dictionary<string, Texture2D>)(object)db[vanillaThemeID][item.Key];
							Texture2D val = (Texture2D)type.GetField(item2.field, item2.bf).GetValue(null);
							dictionary2[item2.field] = new Texture2D(((Texture)val).width, ((Texture)val).height, (TextureFormat)4, false);
							ImageConversion.LoadImage(dictionary2[item2.field], ImageConversion.EncodeToPNG(val));
						}
						else
						{
							Dictionary<string, Color> dictionary3 = (Dictionary<string, Color>)(object)db[vanillaThemeID][item.Key];
							dictionary3[item2.field] = (Color)type.GetField(item2.field, item2.bf).GetValue(null);
						}
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						try
						{
							Dictionary<string, Texture2D> dictionary4 = (Dictionary<string, Texture2D>)(object)db[vanillaThemeID][item.Key];
							Texture2D val2 = (Texture2D)type.GetField(item2.field, item2.bf).GetValue(null);
							((Texture)val2).filterMode = (FilterMode)0;
							RenderTexture val3 = (RenderTexture.active = RenderTexture.GetTemporary(((Texture)val2).width, ((Texture)val2).height));
							Graphics.Blit((Texture)(object)val2, val3);
							Texture2D val4 = new Texture2D(((Texture)val2).width, ((Texture)val2).height, (TextureFormat)4, false);
							val4.ReadPixels(new Rect(0f, 0f, (float)((Texture)val2).width, (float)((Texture)val2).height), 0, 0, false);
							val4.Apply(false);
							RenderTexture.active = null;
							ImageConversion.LoadImage(dictionary4[item2.field], ImageConversion.EncodeToPNG(val4));
							val3.Release();
						}
						catch (Exception ex)
						{
							LogError(string.Concat("saveVanillaRsc (", typeof(T), ")  : Cannot save field ", item.Key, ".", item2.field, " : ", ex.Message));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex3)
			{
				LogError(string.Concat("saveVanillaRsc (", typeof(T), ")  : Cannot get class ", item.Key, " : ", ex3.Message));
			}
		}
	}

	public static Texture2D getThemeTex(string className, string fieldName, string dtheme = "", int index = -1)
	{
		string key = ((!(dtheme != "")) ? Settings.curTheme : dtheme);

		{
			if (!DBTex.ContainsKey(VanillaThemeID) || !DBTex[VanillaThemeID].ContainsKey(className) || !DBTex[VanillaThemeID][className].ContainsKey(fieldName) || (Object)(object)DBTex[VanillaThemeID][className][fieldName] == (Object)null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return DBTex[VanillaThemeID][className][fieldName];
		}
		if (index != -1 && DBTexDyn.ContainsKey(key) && DBTexDyn[key].ContainsKey(className) && DBTexDyn[key][className].ContainsKey(fieldName) && DBTexDyn[key][className][fieldName].Count() > index)
		{
			return DBTexDyn[key][className][fieldName][index];
		}
		return DBTex[key][className][fieldName];
	}

	public static GUIStyle getDBGUIStyle(GameFont gf)
	{
		//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0060: Expected I4, but got Unknown
		//IL_00da: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_00db: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_00dd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_00f0: Expected I4, but got Unknown
		//IL_00f9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_010d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0121: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_012f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		string curTheme = Settings.curTheme;
		if (forcedFontTheme != "")
		{
			curTheme = forcedFontTheme;
		}
		if (Settings.disableCustomFonts || !DBGUIStyle.TryGetValue(curTheme, out var value) || value == null)
		{
			return null;
		}
		switch ((int)gf)
		{
		case 0:
			if (cacheGetDBGUIStyleTiny != null && cacheGetDBGUIStyleTinyTheme == curTheme)
			{
				return cacheGetDBGUIStyleTiny;
			}
			break;
		case 1:
			if (cacheGetDBGUIStyleSmall != null && cacheGetDBGUIStyleSmallTheme == curTheme)
			{
				return cacheGetDBGUIStyleSmall;
			}
			break;
		case 2:
			if (cacheGetDBGUIStyleMedium != null && cacheGetDBGUIStyleMediumTheme == curTheme)
			{
				return cacheGetDBGUIStyleMedium;
			}
			break;
		}
		switch ((int)gf)
		{
		case 0:
			cacheGetDBGUIStyleTinyTheme = curTheme;
			cacheGetDBGUIStyleTiny = value[gf];
			break;
		case 1:
			cacheGetDBGUIStyleSmallTheme = curTheme;
			cacheGetDBGUIStyleSmall = value[gf];
			break;
		case 2:
			cacheGetDBGUIStyleMediumTheme = curTheme;
			cacheGetDBGUIStyleMedium = value[gf];
			break;
		}
		return value[gf];
	}

	public static Texture2D[] getThemeLoader()
	{
		string[] array = Settings.curTheme.Split('');
		if (!DBVal.ContainsKey(VanillaThemeID))
		{
			DBVal[VanillaThemeID] = new Dictionary<string, int>();
			DBVal[VanillaThemeID]["loaderfps"] = 20;
		}
		if (DBNoLoader.ContainsKey(Settings.curTheme) && DBNoLoader[Settings.curTheme])
		{
			return null;
		}
		if (DBLoaderNotFound.ContainsKey(Settings.curTheme) && DBLoaderNotFound[Settings.curTheme])
		{
			return getDefaultLoader();
		}
		if (array[0] == "-1")
		{
			if (!DBLoader.ContainsKey(Settings.curTheme))
			{
				if (!DBNoLoader.ContainsKey(Settings.curTheme))
				{
					string path = Utils.currentMod.RootDir + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Themes" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + array[1] + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Loader" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "NOLOADER";
					if (File.Exists(path))
					{
						DBNoLoader[Settings.curTheme] = true;
						return null;
					}
					DBNoLoader[Settings.curTheme] = false;
				}
				string text = Utils.currentMod.RootDir + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Themes" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + array[1] + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "meta.xml";
				if (File.Exists(text))
				{
					try
					{
						processMetaXML(Settings.curTheme, text);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						LogError("getThemeLoader processing meta.xml : " + ex.Message);
					}
				}
				string text2 = Utils.currentMod.RootDir + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Themes" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + array[1] + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Loader" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Loader.png";
				if (!File.Exists(text2))
				{
					DBLoaderNotFound[Settings.curTheme] = true;
					return getDefaultLoader();
				}
				DBLoaderNotFound[Settings.curTheme] = false;
				if (loadCustomThemeLoader(text2))
				{
					return DBLoader[Settings.curTheme];
				}
				return getDefaultLoader();
			}
			if (DBLoader[Settings.curTheme] == null)
			{
				return getDefaultLoader();
			}
			return DBLoader[Settings.curTheme];
		}
		if (array[0] == "-2")
		{
			if (!DBLoader.ContainsKey(Settings.curTheme))
			{
				string rWBaseFolderPath = Utils.RWBaseFolderPath;
				if (!DBNoLoader.ContainsKey(Settings.curTheme))
				{
					string path2 = rWBaseFolderPath + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "RimThemes" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + array[1] + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Loader" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "NOLOADER";
					if (File.Exists(path2))
					{
						DBNoLoader[Settings.curTheme] = true;
						return null;
					}
					DBNoLoader[Settings.curTheme] = false;
				}
				string text3 = rWBaseFolderPath + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "RimThemes" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + array[1] + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "meta.xml";
				if (File.Exists(text3))
				{
					try
					{
						processMetaXML(Settings.curTheme, text3);
					}
					catch (Exception ex2)
					{
						LogError("getThemeLoader processing meta.xml : " + ex2.Message);
					}
				}
				string text4 = rWBaseFolderPath + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "RimThemes" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + array[1] + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Loader" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Loader.png";
				if (!File.Exists(text4))
				{
					DBLoaderNotFound[Settings.curTheme] = true;
					return getDefaultLoader();
				}
				DBLoaderNotFound[Settings.curTheme] = false;
				if (loadCustomThemeLoader(text4))
				{
					return DBLoader[Settings.curTheme];
				}
				return getDefaultLoader();
			}
			if (DBLoader[Settings.curTheme] == null)
			{
				return getDefaultLoader();
			}
			return DBLoader[Settings.curTheme];
		}
		if (DBLoader.ContainsKey(Settings.curTheme))
		{
			if (DBLoader[Settings.curTheme] == null)
			{
				return getDefaultLoader();
			}
			return DBLoader[Settings.curTheme];
		}
		List<ModContentPack> runningModsListForReading = LoadedModManager.RunningModsListForReading;
		for (int num = runningModsListForReading.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
		{
			ModContentPack val = runningModsListForReading[num];
			if (val.PackageId == array[0])
			{
				if (!DBNoLoader.ContainsKey(Settings.curTheme))
				{
					string path3 = val.RootDir + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "RimThemes" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + array[1] + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Loader" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "NOLOADER";
					if (File.Exists(path3))
					{
						DBNoLoader[Settings.curTheme] = true;
						return null;
					}
					DBNoLoader[Settings.curTheme] = false;
				}
				string text5 = val.RootDir + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "RimThemes" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + array[1] + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "meta.xml";
				if (File.Exists(text5))
				{
					try
					{
						processMetaXML(Settings.curTheme, text5);
					}
					catch (Exception ex3)
					{
						LogError("getThemeLoader processing meta.xml : " + ex3.Message);
					}
				}
				string text6 = val.RootDir + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "RimThemes" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + array[1] + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Loader" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "Loader.png";
				if (File.Exists(text6))
				{
					if (loadCustomThemeLoader(text6))
					{
						DBLoaderNotFound[Settings.curTheme] = false;
						return DBLoader[Settings.curTheme];
					}
					DBLoaderNotFound[Settings.curTheme] = true;
					return getDefaultLoader();
				}
			}
		}
		return getDefaultLoader();
	}

	private static bool loadCustomThemeLoader(string customLoaderPath)
	{
		//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_005a: Expected O, but got Unknown
		//IL_00b5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_00bb: Expected O, but got Unknown
		bool result = true;
		try
		{
			APNG aPNG = new APNG(File.ReadAllBytes(customLoaderPath));
			DBLoader[Settings.curTheme] = (Texture2D[])(object)new Texture2D[aPNG.Frames.Count()];
			Frame[] frames = aPNG.Frames;
			if (aPNG.Frames.Length == 0)
			{
				Texture2D val = new Texture2D(196, 196, (TextureFormat)5, false);
				if (!ImageConversion.LoadImage(val, File.ReadAllBytes(customLoaderPath)))
				{
					throw new Exception();
				}
				DBLoader[Settings.curTheme] = (Texture2D[])(object)new Texture2D[1];
				DBLoader[Settings.curTheme][0] = val;
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 0; i != frames.Count(); i++)
				{
					Texture2D val = new Texture2D(196, 196, (TextureFormat)5, false);
					ImageConversion.LoadImage(val, frames[i].GetStream().ToArray());
					DBLoader[Settings.curTheme][i] = val;
				}
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			result = false;
			if (DBLoader[Settings.curTheme] == null)
			{
				DBLoader[Settings.curTheme] = (Texture2D[])(object)new Texture2D[1];
			}
			for (int j = 0; j != DBLoader[Settings.curTheme].Count(); j++)
			{
				DBLoader[Settings.curTheme][j] = null;
			}
			LogError("Cannot load custom loader for current theme : " + ex.Message);
		}
		return result;
	}

	private static Texture2D[] getDefaultLoader()
	{
		if ((Object)(object)Loader.tex[0] == (Object)null)
		{
			Loader.initTextures();
		}
		return Loader.tex;
	}

	public static string getMenuAlignment()
	{
		if (Settings.menuAlignment == 3)
		{
			return getText("menualignment");
		}
		if (Settings.menuAlignment == 0)
		{
			return "left";
		}
		if (Settings.menuAlignment == 1)
		{
			return "middle";
		}
		return "right";
	}

	public static bool dialogStacking()
	{
		if (Settings.dialogStacking == 1)
		{
			string text = getText("dialogstacking");
			if (text == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (text == "true")
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
		if (Settings.dialogStacking == 2)
		{
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static WindowAnim getWindowAnimation()
	{
		string curTheme = Settings.curTheme;
		WindowAnim windowAnimation = (WindowAnim)Settings.windowAnimation;
		if (windowAnimation == WindowAnim.Theme)
		{
			if (DBWindowAnim.ContainsKey(curTheme))
			{
				return DBWindowAnim[curTheme];
			}
			return WindowAnim.None;
		}
		return (WindowAnim)Settings.windowAnimation;
	}

	public static void drawParticle(Rect rect)
	{
		//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0098: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_00e6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		if (Settings.disableParticle)
		{
			return;
		}
		Texture2D themeParticle = getThemeParticle();
		if (!((Object)(object)themeParticle == (Object)null) && !(((Rect)(ref rect)).width < 80f))
		{
			string text = getText("particlemode");
			bool flag = text == "mono";
			GUI.BeginGroup(rect);
			Rect val = default(Rect);
			((Rect)(ref val))..ctor(9f, ((Rect)(ref rect)).height / 2f - 8f, 16f, 16f);
			Widgets.DrawTextureFitted(val, (Texture)(object)themeParticle, 1f, 1f);
			if (!flag)
			{
				((Rect)(ref val))..ctor(((Rect)(ref rect)).width - 25f, ((Rect)(ref rect)).height / 2f - 8f, 16f, 16f);
				Widgets.DrawTextureFitted(val, (Texture)(object)themeParticle, 1f, 1f);
			}
			GUI.EndGroup();
		}
	}

	public static string[] getClassNameAndFileName(string rscName)
	{
		string[] result = null;
		int num = rscName.LastIndexOf('.');
		if (num + 1 < rscName.Length)
		{
			result = new string[2]
			{
				rscName.Substring(0, num),
				rscName.Substring(num + 1)
			};
		}
		return result;
	}

	public static void setNewRandomBg(bool force = false)
	{
		if (!force && Settings.keepCurrentBg)
		{
			return;
		}
		string text = null;
		if (DBAvailableThemes.Count() <= 0)
		{
			Settings.curRandomBg = VanillaThemeID;
			return;
		}
		List<string> list = DBAvailableThemes.ToList();
		do
		{
			text = GenCollection.RandomElement<string>((IEnumerable<string>)list);
			list.Remove(text);
		}
		while (list.Count() > 0 && text == Settings.curRandomBg);
		Settings.curRandomBg = text;
	}

	public static void setNewRandomBgMain()
	{
		stopCurrentAnimatedBackground();
		LoaderGM.stopCurrentAnimatedbackgroundLoader();
		setNewRandomBg();
	}

	public static string getCustomBackgroundApplyableTheme()
	{
		if (Settings.disableRandomBg || !LoaderGM.themeTexAlreadyLoaded || LoaderGM.curStep <= LoaderSteps.FinishUp)
		{
			return Settings.curTheme;
		}
		if (!DBAvailableThemes.Contains(Settings.curRandomBg))
		{
			setNewRandomBg(force: true);
		}
		return Settings.curRandomBg;
	}

	public static void stopCurrentAnimatedBackground()
	{
		if ((Object)(object)Utils.CurrentMainAnimatedBg != (Object)null)
		{
			Utils.CurrentMainAnimatedBg.Stop();
			Utils.CurrentMainAnimatedBgPlaying = false;
			Utils.CurrentMainAnimatedBgSourceSet = false;
		}
	}
